text:
Ava (Design): Quick upload — new Figma frames for the p95/p99 legend compressions + sampling microcopy. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/latency-dashboards
Ken (Eng-Frontend): Saw it, nice. My first thought: too many percentile chips. Can we collapse into single 'Percentiles' control with checkboxes?
Riley (Observability): Agree. Also we should surface sample rate at the top-level. Users keep asking 'is this full data?'
Priya (Accessibility): Color contrast on current heatmap variant fails AA on p95 hotspot color. We should use higher contrast palette (okabe-ito or WCAG tested). Also keyboard users need focus state on legend chips.
Sam (Eng-ML): For sampled traces, can we show an estimated p95 line with dashed styling + tooltip 'estimated from 10% sample'? That helps set expectations.
Nora (PM): Microcopy suggestion: replace 'Sampling: 1 in N requests' -> 'Observed requests (sampling: 10%)' — clearer for non-technical folks.
Ken (Eng-Frontend): Implementation note — we'll add aria-live on the numeric p95 value so screen readers announce updates when range changes.
Ava (Design): Proposal: default collapsed legend: 'Percentiles ▸' clicking expands to checkboxes for p50/p95/p99. For sampling we show a badge 'Sampled' (orange) with hover tooltip showing rate and method.
Priya (Accessibility): Badge needs proper aria-describedby and high-contrast border. Also ensure tooltip is keyboard reachable.
Riley (Observability): Heatmap idea: add an overlay mode 'density bars' instead of color map for color-blind users. Toggle in settings.
Sam (Eng-ML): snippet of config for how we expose server-side sampling in UI:
```
sampling:
  mode: probabilistic
  rate: 0.10
```
Ken (Eng-Frontend): Also thinking about time-range quick-presets: add 'last 6h/24h/7d' and keyboard shortcuts 'g then 6/24/7' for power users.
Ava (Design): Copy tweak for the dashed estimated line tooltip: 'Estimated p95 based on sample — may differ from full traffic'. Shorter: 'Estimated p95 (sampled)'. Thoughts?
Nora (PM): Love the short copy. Action items: Ava to update Figma, Ken to prototype collapsed legend + aria-live, Priya to audit colors & focus states, Sam to add dashed-line API flag, Riley to mock density-bars.
Ken (Eng-Frontend): I'll ping when prototype is up, probably EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
Priya (Accessibility): :eyes: will run contract checks after prototype
Ava (Design): Thanks team — quick sync Thu 10am if needed. If anyone has objections to the 'Percentiles ▸' pattern speak up now.
